findings.why: Heat H-4471 is offered for release to production, but no 3.1 certificate or tensile test result for it is in the documents. The drawing Rev C and control plan require the certificate review and the SC-01 yield result (>= 250 MPa, EN AW-6082-T6) before release. Someone must supply the certificate and test result for H-4471. The source approval AP-0311 covers BR-220, TO1, STL for Alluminio B, so no source release finding applies.
